text: The American author Peter Neal arrives in Rome to promote his violent new novel, Tenebrae, and finds [a killer quoting his book in letters|origin|stories come true]. A young shoplifter dies by razor, a journalist who calls his writing sexist is murdered with her lover, and a hotel owner's daughter is [hacked down with an axe|images|weapons and tools] after finding the killer's lair. Neal hunts the culprit with his assistant Anne while the police close in, and the trail keeps circling back to [a memory he buried long ago|threat|the enemy within].
